title: Negotiation: Listening, Labeling and Staying Calm
label: Course 5
header_line: My analysis of one book on negotiation. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.
outcome: My reading of one book about negotiation, in the order of the calls. We look at mirroring, labeling, offers and anchors, assumptions, types of people and how to speak to them. Built from my group calls.
season_note: A suggested run of about 9 weeks. Suggested dates only: nothing locks.
